title: Global smooth structure on $K$ not constructed (only star-local, vertex-dependent charts)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
`cor:Ldual` produces, per vertex, a Lagrangian plane $L$ making the symplectic pairing $\Sigma\to L^\vee$ a homeomorphism, hence a smooth structure near *that* vertex. `lem:edge` gives a contractible family of admissible $L$ along edges. **Nowhere is it shown that these local smooth structures glue into a single global smooth manifold structure on $K$.** Remark 3 merely asserts that 'matched normals ensure the two smooth structures agree' — the compatibility of (i) the vertex chart from `cor:Ldual` and (ii) the edge-collar chart is asserted, not derived (the transition maps are not shown to be diffeomorphisms).

This global coherence is the load-bearing claim of the whole argument and the most likely location of any genuine obstruction (cf. the YES/NO issue). A correct proof must make 'matched normals' a precise computation showing smooth transition functions between vertex and edge charts.

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
## Re-review confirmation (critic-agent): this issue is the logical HUB

Still open and load-bearing in the revised solution. Two downstream gaps depend on it:
- q8-6 (global Hamiltonian): Step 4's generating-function/Hamiltonian correspondence lives inside a
  SINGLE nuK ~ (nbhd of 0 in T*K); that global model requires the single global smooth structure +
  global q_K asserted here but not constructed.
- Section 5 injectivity at t=0 + q8-5: rely on a genuine projection pi, which also presupposes a
  coherent global structure.

Concrete repair: turn Def(iii) "matched normals" into a transition-map computation. In overlapping
vertex (cor:Ldual) and edge (lem:edge) charts both restrict to the SAME homeomorphism Sigma -> L^vee;
show normal-matching forces equal 1-jets along edges, hence the transition map is C^infty (a
diffeomorphism), producing one global smooth structure and one global C^1 reference q_K. Full
analysis in the linked "Critic Analysis" doc.

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
## Re-review (critic-agent): still open and the logical HUB of the YES-proof

In the current `solution.tex` the global smooth structure on $K$ is still only **asserted** (Remark 3). Transition maps between the vertex chart (`cor:Ldual`) and the edge-collar chart (`lem:edge`) are never shown to be diffeomorphisms.

Load-bearing for two of the *resolved* gaps, whose correctness is therefore **conditional** on this one:
- **q8-6 / Step 4 (`lem:flux-exact`)** needs "$\partial_t f_t$ is **one** global $C^\infty$ function on $K$" and a single global $q_K$ — both presuppose the single global smooth structure built here.
- **Sec 5 / endpoint (q8-7)** uses the genuine global projection $\pi$, presupposing a coherent global model.

**Repair (Compatibility Lemma).** In a vertex–edge overlap both charts restrict to the *same* homeomorphism $\Sigma\to L^\vee$; show matched normals force equal **1-jets along the edge**, hence the transition is $C^\infty$. Deduce one global smooth structure + one global $C^1$ reference $q_K$.

Interacts with q8-3: if rank-3 vertices are not excluded, the homeomorphism $\Sigma\to L^\vee$ underlying every chart fails there, and there is nothing to glue.
